[Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college)

## Appearance

Roy is an adorably handsome and clever man. He is noted for his glorious dark eyes and a pleading voice. He is also described as having a deep, black, velvety smile.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 ch.Charming P48](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0048), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 ch.Confidences P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036)_

## Personality

Roy Gardner is a clever and extraordinarily handsome individual who treats others with unfailing, deferential courtesy. Characterized as a melancholy and inscrutable hero, he possesses a delightful, pleading voice, though his solemn demeanor leaves little room for perceiving the humorous side of things.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 ch.Confidences P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036)_

## History

Royal Gardner was a handsome [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) student who had previously left college and gone abroad for two years due to his mother's failing health. He met [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) during a sudden rainstorm, rescuing her with his umbrella and walking her home before sending her a dozen roses. After escorting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to a reception and introducing his mother and sisters to her, Roy took her to the harbor pavilion upon their college graduation and proposed. However, [Anne](../character/anne.md) realized she did not love him and refused his offer, leaving Roy deeply upset as they parted ways.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P0](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0000), [v3 ch.Charming P2](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0002), [v3 ch.Charming P3](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0003), [v3 ch.Charming P4](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0004), [v3 ch.Charming P5](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0005), [v3 ch.Charming P6](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0006), +229 more_

## Quotes

> "That ought to be sufficient introduction. My name is Royal Gardner. And you are the Miss Shirley who read the Tennyson paper at the Philomathic the other evening, aren’t you?"
>
> — Roy Gardner — [v3 ch.Charming P36](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0036)

> "I feel as if I didn’t belong anywhere yet. I put in my Freshman and Sophomore years at Redmond two years ago. I’ve been in Europe ever since. Now I’ve come back to finish my Arts course."
>
> — Roy Gardner — [v3 ch.Charming P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038)

> "I can’t understand it—I can’t believe you are not the woman I’ve believed you to be. But reproaches are idle between us. You are the only woman I can ever love. I thank you for your friendship, at least. Good-bye, Anne."
>
> — Roy Gardner — [v3 ch.Dawn P32](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0032)

> "So we are classmates as well as collegemates. I am reconciled to the loss of the years that the locust has eaten,"
>
> — Roy Gardner — [v3 ch.Charming P40](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0040)

> "Pardon me—may I offer you the shelter of my umbrella?"
>
> — Roy Gardner — [v3 ch.Charming P28](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0028)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--roy-gardner.md)

Roy first met [Anne](../character/anne.md) in a park during a sudden rainstorm, offering her his umbrella and walking her home before sending her a dozen roses that same evening. He became her college suitor throughout her time at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), accompanying her to social events like receptions and sending her gifts such as flowers. However, their relationship ended when [Anne](../character/anne.md) ultimately rejected his romantic advances, leaving her feeling disappointed and lonely.

- Romantically involved with — courting college suitor  <sub>[v3 ch.Christine P4](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0004), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 ch.Evening P22](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0022), +3 more</sub>

### [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dorothy--roy-gardner.md)

[Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) is Roy's sister. Along with their mother and another sister, she made a social call to visit [Anne](../character/anne.md) at Patty's Place during Roy's courtship. Though the family arrived a day early and encountered chaotic mishaps during the visit, the meeting was ultimately successful.

- Sibling of — sister  <sub>[v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024), [v3 ch.Weddings P2](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0002)</sub>
